overall.summary: INTZ shows a clear pattern of disclosure degradation in its Q2 2025 10-Q filing. The most concerning signal is the simultaneous removal of specific gross profit figures, margin percentages, and product mix data (Flag 2) combined with the elimination of government contract risk language at precisely the time when government revenue dependence is increasing (Flag 3). Peer comparison further reveals that INTZ's disclosure on cost pressures, geopolitical risks, and cybersecurity operational risks is materially thinner than comparable companies, suggesting a systematic pattern of underreporting risks.
